title: K-tuin, operator of two Apple-product stores in Palma, reports cyberattack that may have affected customer data
geo_basis: city of the two stores (calle Sindicato and Porto Pi), per OKBaleares
summary: OKBaleares reports that K-tuin, which runs two Apple-product stores in Palma, suffered a cyberattack on Monday 23 November and is emailing registered customers about a security incident that may have affected some personal data. The company's notice lists names, phone numbers, national ID numbers, addresses, emails and website order data as possibly affected. It says bank and card details were not compromised.
plain: A Palma retailer of Apple products was hit by a cyberattack and is telling customers that some personal data may have been affected. The company says bank and card details were not compromised.
exec: K-tuin says a cyberattack on 23 November may have affected customer identity, contact and order data; it says bank and card details were not compromised.
action: K-tuin's notice tells customers to stay alert because the data could be used by third parties to attempt impersonation.

validation.note: Only OKBaleares read; it relays K-tuin's customer email. The headline's 'miles' (thousands) is not a count stated in the article, and no number of customers was given.
